title: anonymization
body:
Not sure if this is the right place, but 

I have 75 subjects that have identifying info in a project. I can anonymize them via XNAT now that I have the project anonymization script, but to do so I have to rename each session (and then name it back) causing the project anonymization script to run.

Is there a solution that can anonymize all my scans at once?
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Do you have access to the archive? You could run anonymization right on the archive, though you would need to regenerate the checksums to ensure data consistency.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Yes, but I don't want to necessarily run the anonymization script on the entire archive, just the individual project... I suppose I _could_, but we have very many projects and subjects so it would probably take a very long time.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
The archive is stored by project so it should be pretty straightforward to just run on the project that you want and avoid all others.
